package com.rainbowinventorytags;

import java.awt.Color;
import lombok.Data;

/**
 * Mirrors the shape of the (package-private) {@code Tag} class from RuneLite's built-in
 * "Inventory Tags" plugin ({@code net.runelite.client.plugins.inventorytags.Tag}), which just
 * stores a single {@link Color}. We can't reference that class directly since it isn't public,
 * but the JSON it's serialized to under the {@code inventorytags} config group only has a
 * "color" field, so this lets Gson deserialize it the same way.
 */
@Data
class TagColor
{
	private Color color;
}
